messages:
maya: Kicking off a short dry-run for the staggered shim rollout at 02:30 UTC. This orchestrates API -> version-bridge -> runtime, with console and router header swap. Need quick confirmations on any active pins. @chloe @tom
chloe: No pins on API. Console has a temporary feature-flag for header_v2 in staging only. I'm going to flip it for the dry-run and revert.
tom: Runtime has a pinned pool (v4.2-test) for perf benchmarks; I can unpin that pool at T-20 if we get a clean signal.
arjun: Oncall note: thresholds are in play: error-rate > 0.8% for 2 mins -> abort; 5xx spike > 0.5% -> immediate hold. Also watch auth header rejects, that's a cross-service contract break.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Starting canary pass: id=sb-175987-01 services=[api,version-bridge,runtime] target=staging ttl=8m monitor=[latency,5xx,auth_failures]
maya: Plan: 1) canary small cohort to version-bridge, 2) if stable, flip console.header_v2 in staging, 3) run router header-swap smoke, 4) promote. Rollback policy: prefer single-service rollback unless header schema mismatch.
chloe: Pushing header flag now: console.header_v2=true (staging). Confirmed.
tom: Canary started on runtime side. Observing CPU bump ~6% but OK.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary metrics update: latency +1%, errors 0.05%, auth_failures 0. No abort. Next step scheduled in 4m.
arjun: Seeing an increase in auth rejects on one API shard (0 -> 0.3%). Pattern looks like header parsing mismatch. Can we confirm version-bridge accepts both header formats?
maya: It should. Version-bridge is in compatibility mode for 25m. chloe, can console still send old header shape?
chloe: Yes, console rolled back for that shard; we still accept old shape. I toggled a small subset to new header and it's fine.
tom: Small kv-miss spike on runtime (0.4 -> 1.1 per sec) aligned with canary ramp. I'm leaning to tweak eviction window rather than rollback. Can apply a transient config to canary.
maya: Do that. Keep rollback as option. Add quick rollback snippets to the runbook (for oncall copy/paste).
chloe: Runbook snippet added:
```
# rollback runtime to last stable variant
deployctl rollback --service runtime --to last_stable
# freeze router traffic to stable lane
deployctl set-traffic --service router --mode freeze --lane stable
```
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary pass complete: id=sb-175987-01 status=ok. Proceeding to console header-swap subset.
arjun: Monitoring: auth rejects returned to baseline after subset revert. No 5xx.
maya: Ok, proceed with router header-swap smoke in staging (10% traffic). If router sees >0.3% errors in 3 mins, abort and hold router.
tom: I lowered runtime batch_size on canary (4096->2048) to reduce kv churn. Pushed config.
chloe: Router smoke passed for 10% slice. No errors.
maya: Good. We'll escalate to an extended smoke (50%) for 5 mins. If that passes, schedule final change window. If anything crosses the thresholds we follow single-service rollback first (runtime), otherwise router+console together for contract breaks.
arjun: One more ops ask: attach the migration dry-run log link and the release notes to the change window notification. Oncall wants quick access.
chloe: Done: release notes https://go/release/175987 and smoke logs https://go/logs/smoke/175987
maya: Final signoff pending at T-30. Thanks team. I'll post the production window when ready. :white_check_mark:
